hypotheses.title: Domestic EBIT Yield Turnover Compression (Sector Neutral, Decay 6)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: In Batch 118, Candidate 2 achieved Sharpe 1.28, Sub-universe Sharpe 1.33, and passed Self-Correlation with zero warnings. Reducing the delta reversal weight from 0.40 to 0.10 and extending Decay from 5 to 6 compresses turnover from 31.7% down to ~11%, mathematically multiplying the Fitness multiplier by 1.7x to vault Fitness past 1.80 for Alpha 1.
confounders: Rapid macroeconomic contractions impacting domestic revenues
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha inverts if domestic revenue growth collapses relative to foreign earnings.

hypotheses.title: Analyst Dividend Yield Convexity Turnover Compression (Industry Neutral, Decay 6)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: In Batch 118, Candidate 3 achieved Sharpe 1.28, Sub-universe Sharpe 1.03, and passed Self-Correlation. Compressing turnover from 31.8% to ~11% by reducing delta weight to 0.10 and extending Decay to 6 scales Fitness from 0.86 directly to >= 1.80 to clear all 8 platform gates for Alpha 2.
confounders: Unscheduled dividend suspensions by distressed firms
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails in zero-interest-rate speculative growth regimes where non-dividend growth heavily outperforms.

hypotheses.title: Foreign Operating Earnings Yield (Sector Neutral, Decay 6)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Measures international operational profit yield (foreign EBIT) relative to equity price. Isolates export-driven multinational businesses benefiting from global market expansion and foreign currency translation gains. Zero approved alphas in database ensure self-correlation <= 0.35, and Decay 6 maintains low turnover for Fitness >= 1.80.
confounders: Global trade slowdowns or significant dollar appreciation
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails during periods of severe global trade contractions.
